parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether data is backed up within the same Alibaba Cloud account or across Alibaba Cloud accounts. Valid values:

SELF_ACCOUNT: Data is backed up within the same Alibaba Cloud account.
CROSS_ACCOUNT: Data is backed up across Alibaba Cloud accounts
parameters.help_zh:
跨账号备份类型。支持： 
SELF_ACCOUNT：本账号备份 
CROSS_ACCOUNT：跨账号备份
parameters.name: cross_account_type

parameters.help_en: The UID of the source account used for cross-account backup
parameters.help_zh: 用于跨账号备份的原账号Uid
parameters.name: cross_account_user_id

parameters.help_en: The name of the RAM role that is created within the source Alibaba Cloud account and assigned to the current Alibaba Cloud account to authorize the current Alibaba Cloud account to back up data across Alibaba Cloud accounts
parameters.help_zh: 用于跨账号备份的原账号RAM中创建的角色名
parameters.name: cross_account_role_name

Code.description_en: The HTTP status code. The status code 200 indicates that the request was successful

Limit.description_en: The number of backup snapshots that are displayed on the current page

Message.description_en: The returned message. If the request was successful, "successful" is returned. If the request failed, an error message is returned
Message.description_zh: 返回信息描述，成功一般返回successful，错误时会返回相应错误信息

NextToken.description_en: The token that is required to obtain the next page of backup snapshots
NextToken.description_zh: 获取下一页快照所需的Token

ActualBytes.description_en: The actual data amount of backup snapshots after duplicates are removed. Unit: bytes
ActualBytes.description_zh: 去重后快照实际数据量。单位为字节

BackupType.description_en: The backup type. Valid value: COMPLETE, which indicates full backup
BackupType.description_zh: 备份类型。取值为COMPLETE，表示全量备份

BytesTotal.description_en: The total amount of data. Unit: bytes
BytesTotal.description_zh: 数据源总量。单位为字节

CompleteTime.description_en: The time when the backup snapshot was completed. The value is a UNIX timestamp. Unit: seconds
CompleteTime.description_zh: 备份快照完成时间。UNIX时间，单位为秒

CreateTime.description_en: The time when the Tablestore instance was created. The value is a UNIX timestamp. Unit: seconds
CreateTime.description_zh: 表示表格存储创建时间。UNIX时间，单位为秒

CreatedTime.description_en: The time when the backup snapshot was created. The value is a UNIX timestamp. Unit: seconds
CreatedTime.description_zh: 备份快照的创建时间。UNIX时间，单位为秒

InstanceName.description_en: The name of the Tablestore instance

JobId.description_en: The ID of the backup job

ParentSnapshotHash.description_en: The hash value of the parent backup snapshot

RangeEnd.description_en: The time when the backup job ended. The value is a UNIX timestamp. Unit: milliseconds
RangeEnd.description_zh: 备份任务结束执行时间。UNIX时间，单位为毫秒

RangeStart.description_en: The time when the backup job started. The value is a UNIX timestamp. Unit: milliseconds
RangeStart.description_zh: 备份任务开始执行时间。UNIX时间，单位为毫秒

Retention.description_en: The retention period of the backup snapshot. Unit: days

SnapshotHash.description_en: The hash value of the backup snapshot

SnapshotId.description_en: The ID of the backup snapshot

SourceType.description_en:
The type of the data source. Valid values:

ECS_FILE: backup snapshots for Elastic Compute Service (ECS) files
OSS: backup snapshots for Object Storage Service (OSS) buckets
NAS: backup snapshots for Apsara File Storage NAS file systems
OTS_TABLE: backup snapshots for Tablestore instances
SourceType.description_zh:
数据源类型。取值范围：

ECS_FILE：ECS文件的备份快照。
OSS：阿里云OSS的备份快照。
NAS：阿里云NAS的备份快照。
OTS_TABLE：阿里云表格存储的备份快照

StartTime.description_en: The time when the backup snapshot started. The value is a UNIX timestamp. Unit: seconds
StartTime.description_zh: 快照开始时间。UNIX时间，单位为秒

Status.description_en:
The status of the backup job. Valid values:

COMPLETE: The backup job is completed.
PARTIAL_COMPLETE: The backup job is partially completed.
FAILED: The backup job has failed
Status.description_zh:
备份快照任务的状态。取值范围：

COMPLETE：成功
PARTIAL_COMPLETE：部分成功
FAILED：失败

TableName.description_en: The name of the table in the Tablestore instance
TableName.description_zh: 表格存储实例的数据表名称

UpdatedTime.description_en: The time when the backup snapshot was updated. The value is a UNIX timestamp. Unit: seconds
UpdatedTime.description_zh: 备份快照的更新时间。UNIX时间，单位为秒

VaultId.description_en: The ID of the backup vault that stores the backup snapshot
VaultId.description_zh: 保存备份库快照的仓库ID

Indicates whether the request was successful. Valid values:

true
false

请求是否成功。

true：成功。
